vial_spin_stop_sequence — PHARMA synth op

• Data kinds: none → video (an op determined by its arguments alone — it takes no image or data input)

• Call: import fullseye as fs; fs.ledger.vial_spin_stop_sequence(shape=(96, 72), *, n_frames=18, frame_interval_s=0.04, initial_omega_rad_s=10.0, decay_time_s=0.25, vial_radius_mm=10.0, liquid_height_mm=28.0, particle_diameter_um=80.0, particle_density_kg_m3=1450.0, particle_contrast=0.16, illumination='back', n_particles=1, n_bubbles=1, n_scratches=1, viscosity_pa_s=0.003, fluid_density_kg_m3=1000.0, pixel_size_um=280.0, noise_sigma=0.012, seed=0) (to call the implementation directly, import vialops; vialops.vial_spin_stop_sequence(shape=(96, 72), *, n_frames=18, frame_interval_s=0.04, initial_omega_rad_s=10.0, decay_time_s=0.25, vial_radius_mm=10.0, liquid_height_mm=28.0, particle_diameter_um=80.0, particle_density_kg_m3=1450.0, particle_contrast=0.16, illumination='back', n_particles=1, n_bubbles=1, n_scratches=1, viscosity_pa_s=0.003, fluid_density_kg_m3=1000.0, pixel_size_um=280.0, noise_sigma=0.012, seed=0); from the registry, opspharma.get("vial_spin_stop_sequence"))

• Return value through the ledger: fullseye.ledger.vial_spin_stop_sequence(...) returns only the declared out type video (the underlying function also returns auxiliary values). When you need what was dropped, use fullseye.ledger.vial_spin_stop_sequence.raw(...) or call vialops.vial_spin_stop_sequence directly.

• GPU: none (CPU reference implementation only)

Usage

Create a post-spin-stop vial image sequence and per-object ground-truth trajectories.

The liquid azimuthal velocity is the axisymmetric, prescribed field u_theta(r,t) = omega0 exp(-t/tau) r; it is not a Navier--Stokes solution. A particle has that in-plane advection plus its Stokes terminal velocity v_t = 2 r_p^2 (rho_p-rho_f) g / (9 mu) in the image-downward direction. Bubbles use rho_p=1.2 kg/m^3 and therefore rise. The model is restricted to small Reynolds number / isolated spherical objects where Stokes drag is appropriate; it does not model turbulent wake, aggregation, meniscus forces, or wall-corrected drag. At the cylindrical wall positions are reflected, which prevents a silent escape but is not a hydrodynamic wall model. Refraction through glass and liquid is deliberately simplified to a fixed apparent contrast and Gaussian PSF in this first stage.

illumination is "back" or "side". A fixed seed determines object positions, sensor noise, and scratches. The direct return is (frames, truth); truth contains a row table with object type, frame, projected positions, physical positions and visibility, plus angular-speed truth. The ledger adapter returns only the video frames.

Raises ValueError for nonphysical dimensions, an unknown illumination, or a nonintegral object count.
